mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to distinguish between safe and unsafe operating conditions at a CCP."
A critical limit is used to distinguish between safe and unsafe operating conditions at a CCP.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as a biological, chemical or physical agent that is reasonably likely to cause illness or injury in the absence of its control."
A hazard is defined as a biological, chemical or physical agent that is reasonably likely to cause illness or injury in the absence of its control.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the emission or transmission of energy in the form of waves or particles through space or through a material medium."
Radiation is the emission or transmission of energy in the form of waves or particles through space or through a material medium.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used for burning waste in either solid, liquid, or sludge form."
Special types of thermal equipment are used for burning waste in either solid, liquid, or sludge form.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a combination of the probability that a particular outcome will occur and the severity of the harm involved."
A risk is a combination of the probability that a particular outcome will occur and the severity of the harm involved.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a concept in politics and environmental policy that advocates sustainable development as the supreme consideration for managing all human activities (political, social and economic)."

Environmental governance is a concept in politics and environmental policy that advocates sustainable development as the supreme consideration for managing all human activities (political, social and economic).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an attractive weapon because biological agents are relatively easy and inexpensive to obtain, can be easily disseminated, and can cause widespread fear and panic beyond the actual physical damage."

Bioterrorism is an attractive weapon because biological agents are relatively easy and inexpensive to obtain, can be easily disseminated, and can cause widespread fear and panic beyond the actual physical damage.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are an effective form of tertiary treatment and are widely used in industry, particularly for beverage preparation (including bottled water)."
Membrane filters are an effective form of tertiary treatment and are widely used in industry, particularly for beverage preparation (including bottled water).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the best known disease vector."
Mosquitoes are the best known disease vector.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an aspect of public health that links factors in the environment to human health conditions."
Environmental health is an aspect of public health that links factors in the environment to human health conditions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a change in the distribution of weather patterns when that change lasts for an extended period of time."
Climate change is a change in the distribution of weather patterns when that change lasts for an extended period of time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to prevent guests from climbing into the exhibit or falling into the moat."
Signs and railings are used to prevent guests from climbing into the exhibit or falling into the moat.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the range of all possible electromagnetic radiation frequencies."
The electromagnetic spectrum is the range of all possible electromagnetic radiation frequencies.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the human being's ability to function successfully when environmental factors are constantly changing."
Health refers to the human being's ability to function successfully when environmental factors are constantly changing.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the complex of physical, chemical and biotic factors (as climate, soil, and living things) that act upon an organism or an ecological community and ultimately determine its form and survival."

The environment is defined as the complex of physical, chemical and biotic factors (as climate, soil, and living things) that act upon an organism or an ecological community and ultimately determine its form and survival.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to almost all particles in the air and is typically measured as PM mass up to particles of about 45 microns in diameter."
Total suspended particles (TSP) refers to almost all particles in the air and is typically measured as PM mass up to particles of about 45 microns in diameter.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the greatest contributors to climate change as they trap and reemit infrared rays towards the earth surface, thus creating a warmer atmosphere with its consequent impact on weather and human health."

Greenhouse gases are the greatest contributors to climate change as they trap and reemit infrared rays towards the earth surface, thus creating a warmer atmosphere with its consequent impact on weather and human health.
